papers.title: Scene-Conditioned Relation Routing for urban cellular activity forecasting
papers.title_zh: 面向城市蜂窝活动预测的场景条件关系路由
papers.reason: 该文提出场景条件关系路由框架用于城市蜂窝活动预测，直接涉及城市时空数据挖掘、多源信号融合与可解释路由，与研究方向高度契合。
papers.abstract: Urban cellular activity forecasting requires jointly modeling heterogeneous spatiotemporal signals, including SMS usage, mobile network traffic, and call activity. Existing methods often separate temporal modeling, spatial relation learning, and multi-signal prediction, relying on fixed graph structures or static multi-task learning schemes, which limits their adaptability to changing urban scenes. We propose SCRR-Net, a scene-conditioned spatial relation routing framework in which urban contextual information jointly controls spatial dependency selection and cross-task knowledge transfer. SCRR-Net includes a context encoder, a spatial graph expert routing module, a temporal Transformer encoder, and a task knowledge routing module. Experiments on the Milano and Trento datasets demonstrate that SCRR-Net consistently outperforms competing methods on SMS, network traffic, and call activity forecasting, while providing interpretable routing behaviors.
papers.summary_zh: 城市蜂窝活动预测需要联合建模异构时空信号，包括短信使用、移动网络流量和通话活动。现有方法通常将时间建模、空间关系学习和多信号预测分离，依赖固定图结构或静态多任务学习方案，限制了其对变化城市场景的适应性。作者提出SCRR-Net，一种场景条件空间关系路由框架，其中城市上下文信息共同控制空间依赖选择与跨任务知识迁移。SCRR-Net包含上下文编码器、空间图专家路由模块、时间Transformer编码器和任务知识路由模块。在Milano和Trento数据集上的实验表明，SCRR-Net在短信、网络流量和通话活动预测上持续优于对比方法，同时提供可解释的路由行为。
papers.insight_zh: 该文表明，将城市上下文作为路由条件来动态选择空间依赖与跨任务迁移，可提升多源城市时空信号预测并增强可解释性；这一思路可启发城市更新中多源时空指标（如人口、活动、通信）的联合建模与动态关系发现。

papers.title: Limits of Reliability and Scaling in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 语言模型可靠性与扩展的极限
papers.reason: 论文深入探讨语言模型的可靠性和扩展极限，对GIS中依赖LLM进行时空数据挖掘和决策支持时的风险控制具有重要指导意义。
papers.summary_zh: 本文分析了语言模型在可靠性和规模扩展方面的内在限制，指出当前模型在特定任务上的性能瓶颈和潜在风险。
papers.insight_zh: 在将LLM用于城市更新分析时，需认识到其可靠性边界，避免在关键决策中过度依赖模型输出。

papers.title: FedeRICo: Federated Region-Influenced Coupling for Traffic Flow Prediction
papers.title_zh: FedeRICo：面向交通流预测的联邦区域影响耦合
papers.reason: 该文研究联邦设置下的城市交通流预测，涉及时空数据挖掘、跨客户端空间依赖恢复和隐私约束，与GIS博士研究中的时空数据挖掘和城市分析方向高度相关。
papers.abstract: Urban traffic forecasting often relies on information distributed across stakeholders who may be unable to share raw data due to privacy or commercial constraints, motivating federated spatial-temporal approaches. In such federated settings, each client observes traffic over a distinct sensor subgraph with its own spatial topology and temporal dynamics, leading to significant heterogeneity across clients. Existing federated spatial-temporal methods typically rely on model parameter aggregation and provide limited mechanisms for recovering spatial dependencies across client boundaries. This introduces two key limitations. Specifically, parameter aggregation across heterogeneous graph domains tends to dilute client-specific representations, while road network partitioning breaks the propagation of traffic dynamics across client boundaries. To address these challenges, we propose FedeRICo, a federated traffic forecasting framework that combines gradient-level collaboration with boundary-aware residual communication. FedeRICo employs a dual-branch forecasting architecture in which a globally guided branch captures transferable forecasting structure, while a private residual branch preserves client-specific corrections and incorporates boundary residual signals. The global branch is coordinated through gradient alignment across all clients, enabling collaborative optimisation without destructive parameter interference. To recover cross-client spatial dependencies, boundary messages are extracted through a trend-residual decomposition that suppresses periodic structure and communicates only transient spatial-temporal residual signals between physically adjacent clients. Experiments across four real-world traffic forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that FedeRICo consistently outperforms state-of-the-art federated spatial-temporal baselines while maintaining competitive training runtime.
papers.summary_zh: 城市交通预测通常依赖分布在多个利益相关方之间的信息，而这些方可能因隐私或商业约束无法共享原始数据，这推动了联邦时空方法的发展。在此类联邦设定中，每个客户端观测不同传感器子图上的交通，具有自己的空间拓扑和时间动态，导致客户端间显著异质性。现有联邦时空方法通常依赖模型参数聚合，恢复跨客户端边界空间依赖的机制有限。这带来两个关键局限：跨异质图域的参数聚合倾向于稀释客户端特定表示，而路网划分破坏了交通动态跨客户端边界的传播。为应对这些挑战，作者提出FedeRICo，一种联邦交通预测框架，结合梯度级协作与边界感知残差通信。FedeRICo采用双分支预测架构，其中全局引导分支捕获可迁移的预测结构，而私有残差分支保留客户端特定修正并纳入边界残差信号。全局分支通过所有客户端间的梯度对齐进行协调，实现无破坏性参数干扰的协作优化。为恢复跨客户端空间依赖，边界消息通过趋势—残差分解提取，抑制周期性结构并仅在物理相邻客户端之间传递瞬态时空残差信号。在四个真实世界交通预测基准上的实验表明，FedeRICo持续优于……
papers.insight_zh: 该文指出联邦时空预测中参数聚合会稀释客户端特征且路网划分会切断跨边界传播，并用梯度对齐加边界残差通信来缓解；这对城市多源数据融合和隐私约束下的时空建模具有直接方法学参考价值。

papers.title: JointMatch: A Unified Heterogeneous Graph Neural Solver for Large-Scale Ride-Sharing Matching
papers.title_zh: JointMatch：面向大规模拼车匹配的统一异构图神经求解器
papers.reason: 该文研究大规模拼车匹配的异构图神经求解器，属于城市交通与时空优化问题，与城市时空数据挖掘和地理空间智能相关，但不涉及城市更新或遥感。
papers.abstract: Ride-sharing platforms must continuously decide which open requests to bundle into shared trips and which idle vehicles should serve them. The dominant academic approach decomposes this into two sequential matching problems -- request pairing first, then vehicle assignment -- and applies a separate solver to each. This decomposition is convenient computationally but loses revenue and scales poorly because the first stage commits to ride bundles before the available vehicles are known. We propose JointMatch, a learning-based framework that handles request pairing and vehicle assignment together on a single graph. The graph is sparsified by spatial proximity so that its size grows linearly rather than quadratically with the number of vehicles and requests, and a graph neural network scores all candidate decisions in one forward pass. On the New York City Yellow Taxi data, the framework already exceeds both the classical Blossom heuristic and a faithfully-trained two-stage GNN baseline -- often by a wide margin -- and at city scale (fleet 10000) it runs more than $20\times$ faster per dispatch epoch than either. A supervised training stage closes most of the remaining revenue gap, and a policy-gradient fine-tune aligns the trained model with realised revenue.
papers.summary_zh: 拼车平台必须持续决定哪些开放请求可捆绑为共享行程，以及哪些空闲车辆应服务这些请求。主流学术方法将其分解为两个顺序匹配问题——先请求配对，再车辆分配——并对每个问题应用单独求解器。这种分解在计算上方便，但会损失收入且扩展性差，因为第一阶段在可用车辆未知时就已确定行程捆绑。作者提出JointMatch，一种基于学习的框架，在单一图上同时处理请求配对与车辆分配。该图通过空间邻近性稀疏化，使其规模随车辆和请求数量线性而非二次增长，图神经网络在一次前向传播中为所有候选决策打分。在纽约市黄色出租车数据上，该框架已超过经典Blossom启发式和忠实训练的两阶段GNN基线——往往优势明显——在城市规模（车队10000）下，每个调度轮次运行速度比二者快20倍以上。监督训练阶段缩小了大部分剩余收入差距，策略梯度微调使训练模型与实现收入对齐。
papers.insight_zh: 该文展示将空间邻近稀疏化与图神经网络结合，可在城市规模组合优化中同时提升收入与计算效率；其统一图建模与端到端学习思路，对城市更新中的设施选址、资源调度等空间优化问题具有方法借鉴意义。

papers.title: Towards Proactive Detection of User-Side Implicit Conflicts in Human-LLM Dialogue
papers.title_zh: 迈向主动检测人-LLM对话中的用户侧隐式冲突
papers.reason: 该文研究人-LLM对话中用户侧隐式冲突的主动检测，构建UC-Bench基准并提出约束引导的数据合成方法SynUC，与研究中LLM与多智能体方向直接相关，可用于对话式地理空间智能体中的意图一致性维护。
papers.abstract: In Human-LLM dialogue, follow-up user utterances may implicitly conflict with earlier intents, leading the LLM to misinterpret user needs and generate inappropriate responses. A reliable dialogue system should proactively detect user-side conflicts before generating a response and seek clarification when necessary. However, prior work has largely focused on LLM-side conflicts, leaving user-side conflicts underexplored. To fill this gap, we construct UC-Bench, a human-annotated benchmark for evaluating user-side conflict detection. Preliminary experiments show that existing LLMs struggle with this task, especially when conflicts arise from implicit incompatibilities grounded in dialogue history. To improve lightweight LLMs with limited training data, we investigate data synthesis for user-side conflict detection. Existing synthesis methods do not explicitly model the implicit incompatibilities between historical and current user utterances, making it difficult to capture the evolution of conflicts and to generate reliably labeled implicit conflict samples. We propose SynUC, a constraint-guided synthesis method that represents user-side conflicts in a constraint space and uses the SPEAKING framework to guide traceable constraint transformations. Applying SynUC to WildChat, we construct UC-Data, a user-side conflict training set containing 2,487 samples. On UC-Bench, Qwen3.5-4B trained on UC-Data outperforms larger general-purpose LLMs such as Claude Opus 4.8, as well as the same backbone trained on data synthesized by existing methods.
papers.summary_zh: 在人-LLM对话中，后续用户话语可能与先前意图隐式冲突，导致LLM误解用户需求并生成不当回应。可靠的对话系统应在生成回应前主动检测用户侧冲突并在必要时寻求澄清。然而，已有工作多聚焦于LLM侧冲突，用户侧冲突研究不足。为填补这一空白，作者构建了UC-Bench，一个经人工标注的基准，用于评估用户侧冲突检测。初步实验表明，现有LLM在该任务上表现不佳，尤其当冲突源于对话历史中的隐式不兼容时。为在有限训练数据下改进轻量级LLM，作者研究了面向用户侧冲突检测的数据合成。现有合成方法未显式建模历史与当前用户话语之间的隐式不兼容，难以捕捉冲突演化并生成可靠标注的隐式冲突样本。作者提出SynUC，一种约束引导的合成方法，将用户侧冲突表示在约束空间中，并使用SPEAKING框架引导可追溯的约束变换。将SynUC应用于WildChat，作者构建了UC-Data，一个包含2,487个样本的用户侧冲突训练集。在UC-Bench上，使用UC-Data训练的Qwen3.5-4B优于Claude Opus 4.8等更大的通用LLM，也优于在现有方法合成数据上训练的同一骨干模型。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提示：在构建面向城市更新等领域的LLM对话助手时，用户意图可能随对话推进而隐式漂移，主动冲突检测与澄清机制值得纳入系统设计；其约束空间建模思路或可迁移到地理空间任务约束（如时空范围、分析目标）的一致性校验。

papers.title: An Analysis of Training-Free Self-Reported Confidence in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 语言模型中免训练自报置信度的分析
papers.reason: 该文分析语言模型自报置信度的可靠性，涉及LLM评估与不确定性量化，与研究中LLM与多智能体方向相关，但不涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。
papers.abstract: Large language models can report a numerical confidence together with generated content, but it is unclear whether this report is more than calibrated rhetoric. We analyze three training-free signals: confidence verbalized with the answer, post-hoc $P(\mathrm{True})$, and agreement with three additional generations on the same 100 TriviaQA questions for two model families. Direct verbalization is a surprisingly strong baseline: after auditing benchmark errors, it reaches AUROC 0.956 and 0.937 for correctness prediction. Three-sample agreement is substantially weaker (0.765 and 0.790), and a fixed interpolation with verbalized confidence has no statistically reliable benefit. Four of nine errors from one model and two of eight from the other receive unanimous sample support, showing that self-consistency can amplify shared misconceptions. Re-eliciting confidence for the same fixed answers with equivalent prompts changes scores by 0.043 to 0.084 on average and flips 4\% to 9\% of decisions at a 0.8 threshold. An exploratory audit of 100 confidence-tagged biography claims further finds only a modest confidence gap between supported and contradicted claims. These results argue that useful self-reports remain sensitive to elicitation, correlated errors, and benchmark noise.
papers.summary_zh: 大语言模型可以在生成内容的同时报告一个数值置信度，但这一报告是否只是经过校准的修辞尚不清楚。本文分析了三种免训练信号：随答案口头表达的置信度、事后P(True)概率，以及在100个TriviaQA问题上与另外三次生成结果的一致性，覆盖两个模型家族。直接口头表达是一个出人意料的强基线：在审查基准错误后，其对正确性预测的AUROC达到0.956和0.937。三次采样一致性明显更弱（0.765和0.790），而与口头置信度的固定插值没有统计上可靠的收益。一个模型的九个错误中有四个、另一个模型的八个错误中有两个获得了一致的采样支持，表明自一致性可能放大共同的误解。用等价提示对相同固定答案重新引出置信度，平均会使分数变化0.043至0.084，并在0.8阈值下翻转4%至9%的决策。对100条带置信度标签的传记性陈述的探索性审查进一步发现，被支持与被反驳的陈述之间置信度差距仅为中等。这些结果表明，有用的自报置信度仍然对引出方式、相关错误和基准噪声敏感。
papers.insight_zh: 若将LLM用于地理空间智能或多智能体决策，其自报置信度可作为不确定性信号，但需注意其对提示方式敏感且可能放大共同错误，因此不宜单独作为可靠性依据。

papers.title: For Your Eyes Only: Evaluating Coordination Between Isolated Language Model Instances
papers.title_zh: 仅供你眼：评估隔离语言模型实例之间的协调
papers.reason: 该论文研究隔离语言模型实例之间的协调与信号传递，属于LLM与多智能体交互范畴，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但不涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。
papers.abstract: As model-generated content is increasingly consumed by other model instances in automated workflows, a practically important question arises: can a model embed a signal in natural language that an independent instance of the same model can detect, relying only on shared pre-training and task instructions, without any shared memory or coordination-specific training? We introduce For Your Eyes Only, a cooperative signalling game designed to evaluate this directly. A Sender produces free-form descriptions for two words, one of which is a hidden target; an isolated Receiver must identify it. We evaluate seven contemporary models from four architectural families on 300 word pairs from established psycholinguistic corpora, using the Double-Pass Success Rate to control for output biases. We find that most models struggle to maintain coordination once they are required to avoid detectable signals, while one frontier model retains near-perfect performance even after such filtering. We further show that models can direct this capability toward deliberate misdirection, and that coordination is consistently weaker across architectures than within them.
papers.summary_zh: 随着模型生成内容在自动化工作流中越来越多地被其他模型实例消费，一个实际重要的问题出现了：模型能否在自然语言中嵌入一种信号，使同一模型的独立实例仅依靠共享预训练和任务指令、而无需共享记忆或专门协调训练即可检测到？作者提出“For Your Eyes Only”合作信号博弈来直接评估这一点。发送者为两个词生成自由形式描述，其中一个是隐藏目标；一个隔离的接收者必须识别它。作者在来自已建立心理语言学语料库的300个词对上评估了来自四个架构家族的七个当代模型，使用双通过成功率来控制输出偏差。研究发现，大多数模型一旦被要求避免可检测信号就难以维持协调，而一个前沿模型即使经过此类过滤仍保持近乎完美的表现。作者进一步表明模型可以将这种能力用于故意误导，并且跨架构的协调始终弱于同一架构内的协调。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提示：在LLM驱动的多智能体地理空间工作流中，若需要模型间隐式协作或防泄漏通信，跨架构协调可能不可靠；同时模型可能具备故意误导能力，这对多智能体决策的可信性构成潜在风险。

papers.title: Bayesian Optimization with Rich Auxiliary Information via LLMs
papers.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的丰富辅助信息贝叶斯优化
papers.reason: 该论文研究利用大语言模型整合丰富辅助信息以指导贝叶斯优化，与研究中LLM与智能体方法相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用，属于方法层面的间接参考。
papers.abstract: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely used for optimizing expensive black-box functions, yet many real-world optimization problems contain substantially richer information than function evaluations alone. Examples include training curves in hyperparameter optimization, expert notes and images in scientific experimentation, and prior knowledge about where optima may lie. We show that large language models (LLMs) can effectively leverage such rich auxiliary information to guide optimization. Motivated by these findings, we develop three methods for incorporating auxiliary information into BO using LLMs. Across hyperparameter optimization benchmarks and a real-world nuclear fusion optimization task, our methods consistently outperform both standard BO and existing LLM-based optimization approaches. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of LLMs for leveraging rich auxiliary information in BO.
papers.summary_zh: 贝叶斯优化广泛用于优化昂贵的黑盒函数，但许多现实优化问题包含比函数评估更丰富的信息，例如超参数优化中的训练曲线、科学实验中的专家笔记和图像，以及关于最优解可能位置的先验知识。作者表明大语言模型能够有效利用这些丰富辅助信息来指导优化，并据此提出三种将辅助信息通过LLM融入贝叶斯优化的方法。在超参数优化基准和真实核聚变优化任务上，这些方法持续优于标准贝叶斯优化和现有基于LLM的优化方法。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提示LLM可作为融合非结构化辅助信息的优化引导器，其思路或可迁移至地理空间优化问题，但论文本身未涉及地理或城市应用，需谨慎推断。

papers.title: When Does Retrieval Help Time-Series Forecasting?
papers.title_zh: 检索何时有助于时间序列预测？
papers.reason: 该文研究检索插件对时间序列预测的增益边界，属于时空数据挖掘与预测方法评估范畴，与研究方向中的时空数据挖掘相关，但不涉及城市更新、遥感或LLM多智能体。
papers.abstract: Retrieval plug-ins supply a deep forecaster with information its lookback window cannot carry. Published evaluations report consistent gains, and each credits its own mechanism. We show that the benefit belongs instead to the operating point: the relation between window length $S$ and dominant seasonal period $L$, an axis the standard protocol never varies. Stratifying the evaluation by that relation exposes the regime. At $S{=}12$, a simple control that repeats the last observed period beats the six standard backbones, in aggregate, on four of seven benchmarks by $8\%$ to $44\%$ of MSE. It beats the strongest plug-in we run on ETTm1 and matches it on ECL. It is worse by up to $25\%$ on the three datasets whose training-split spectra lack a concentrated, shared period. A controlled synthetic sweep of horizon, period, and window shows the benefit boundary tracks the period (correlation $+0.71$), not the horizon ($-0.23$). A paired control with no phase to recover nearly erases the effect, consistent with phase starvation. Zero-shot pretraining does not escape it: a foundation model trails trained backbones by $22\%$ to $50\%$ on the periodic benchmarks. Within our instrument, exact lookup matches graph diffusion: the payoff is consulting the record, not the machinery on top. Two interpretable statistics, a trend test and a staleness rate, predict the sign of the per-cell benefit at $0.76$ accuracy under leave-one-dataset-out evaluation, a suggestive margin over the $0.69$ majority rule, where a 22-feature stack manages $0.57$. We propose no new plug-in. The contribution is the regime map, the protocol that reveals it, and two statistics that screen it before deployment. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/retrieval-regime.

papers.abstract: Compositional reasoning is critical for real-world problem solving: since training data is necessarily limited, models must generalize by composing learned skills in new ways. While post-training methods such as reinforcement learning (RL) have substantially improved the reasoning abilities of language models (LMs), their effects on compositional reasoning remain less well understood. We propose a dependency-graph framework to formalize compositional reasoning, yielding three levels of compositionality with increasing complexity. Empirically, we instantiate this framework with data-structure tasks, which provide deterministic reward computation and clear compositional structure. We find a consistent decomposed-to-composed asymmetry: decomposed-skill training does not reliably transfer to composed tasks, whereas composed-task training transfers more readily back to decomposed tasks. We provide theoretical explanation for this asymmetry, and further evaluate compositional generalization under length extrapolation, structural distribution shift, and transfer to tasks requiring unseen skills. Finally, we present a pilot study on real-world tool-calling benchmarks, showing preliminary evidence that the decomposed-to-composed asymmetry can extend to practical settings.
papers.summary_zh: 组合推理对现实世界问题求解至关重要：由于训练数据必然有限，模型必须通过以新方式组合已学技能来泛化。尽管强化学习（RL）等后训练方法显著提升了语言模型（LM）的推理能力，但其对组合推理的影响仍不太清楚。作者提出依赖图框架来形式化组合推理，产生三个复杂度递增的组合层级。在实证上，他们用数据结构任务实例化该框架，这些任务提供确定性奖励计算和清晰的组合结构。作者发现一致的“分解到组合”不对称性：分解技能训练不能可靠迁移到组合任务，而组合任务训练更容易迁移回分解任务。作者为该不对称性提供理论解释，并进一步评估长度外推、结构分布偏移以及迁移到需要未见技能任务下的组合泛化。最后，作者在真实工具调用基准上进行初步研究，显示“分解到组合”不对称性可能延伸到实际场景的初步证据。

papers.title: Towards Safer RAG: Only Agents Capable of System 2 Thinking may Access Untrusted Documents

papers.reason: 研究探讨了RAG系统中的知识污染攻击，并提出基于推理能力的访问控制原则，对构建安全可靠的LLM应用有直接指导意义，与地理空间智能中基于RAG的知识问答系统安全设计相关。
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has significantly enhanced the performance of large language models (LLMs), yet these systems remain vulnerable to knowledge-poisoning attacks, in which misinformation in retrieved documents can influence the model's final outputs. Notably, an LLM may correctly detect that a document contains incorrect information while nevertheless being influenced by it. Prior work has addressed this vulnerability through the Cordon Principle, which prevents models responsible for final answer synthesis from directly accessing raw evidence. Although effective, this strict isolation can introduce substantial computational overhead. In this work, we propose a refined security principle: only agents capable of deliberative System 2 reasoning may access untrusted documents. To evaluate this principle, we introduce novel metrics that quantify the discrepancy between misinformation detection and downstream influence. We then empirically compare state-of-the-art reasoning language models with standard language models across these metrics. Our results show that reasoning-capable models are substantially more robust to corrupted evidence, without requiring the strict isolation imposed by the Cordon Principle. These findings provide empirical support for our refined principle and suggest a more practical foundation for secure RAG system design.
papers.summary_zh: 针对RAG系统中的知识污染攻击，提出一项安全原则：只有能够进行深思熟虑的系统2推理的智能体才能访问不受信任的文档。通过新指标量化错误信息检测与下游影响之间的差异，并比较推理语言模型和标准语言模型，发现推理模型对受损证据的鲁棒性显著更高。
papers.insight_zh: 具备推理能力的语言模型对检索到的错误信息具有更强的鲁棒性，这为设计更安全的RAG系统提供了实证支持，无需采用严格的隔离原则。

papers.reason: 该论文研究通过LLM内部潜状态检测有害内容，属于LLM安全与可解释性，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但不涉及地理空间应用。
papers.abstract: Autonomous systems increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) yet the safety infrastructure surrounding these models introduces latency and compute overhead. This limits utility in resource-constrained, time-critical deployments. Existing external guardrail models remain blind to the model's internal workings, creating a fundamental assurance gap. We ask: does the model already know when the content is harmful? We extract activations from LLaMA-3.1-8B and train lightweight MLP classifier probes (12.6M parameters) to detect harmful prompts. Evaluated on WildJailbreak, Beavertails, and AEGIS 2.0, our probes achieve F1 scores of 99%, 83%, and 84%, respectively competitive with 1000x larger guard models while cutting latency and compute costs.
papers.summary_zh: 自主系统日益依赖大语言模型（LLM），但围绕这些模型的安全基础设施带来延迟和计算开销，限制了在资源受限、时间关键部署中的效用。现有外部护栏模型对模型内部工作机制不可见，造成根本性的保障缺口。作者提问：模型是否已经知道内容有害？他们从LLaMA-3.1-8B提取激活，训练轻量MLP分类器探针（1260万参数）来检测有害提示。在WildJailbreak、Beavertails和AEGIS 2.0上评估，探针分别达到99%、83%和84%的F1分数，与大1000倍的护栏模型相比具有竞争力，同时降低延迟和计算成本。

papers.title: Less Is More: Graph-free Multimodal RAG via Multi-signal Late Fusion
papers.title_zh: 少即是多：基于多信号后期融合的无图多模态RAG

papers.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely used for multimodal, cross-document question answering. However, building corpus-level graphs is expensive, slow to query, and difficult to maintain. We present TrioRAG, a graph-free multimodal framework that integrates evidence from three complementary signals: the question, the anchor image, and a VLM-enhanced query generated from both. Each signal retrieves independently over a shared multi-vector index of page text and page images, and the results are combined through late fusion. Further, we introduce AutoQA, a multimodal automotive benchmark whose questions are grounded in noisy, web-sourced images rather than clean document-sourced figures. Its questions require reasoning across manuals. We position it as a model-curated testbed rather than a human-validated gold standard. Across three benchmarks, TrioRAG matches or outperforms graph-based systems while reducing total cost and accelerating per-query inference by 1.6-2.3 times. By construction, AutoQA grounds its questions in out-of-corpus web images. In this setting image retrieval reaches only 19.3% document-level recall, while text-derived signals, especially the VLM-enhanced query, keep retrieval robust.
papers.summary_zh: 基于图的检索增强生成广泛用于多模态跨文档问答，但构建语料级图成本高、查询慢且难以维护。作者提出TrioRAG，一个无图多模态框架，整合问题、锚点图像以及由二者生成的VLM增强查询三种互补信号，各信号在共享的页面文本与图像多向量索引上独立检索，并通过后期融合合并结果。作者还提出AutoQA多模态汽车基准，其问题基于嘈杂的网络图像而非干净的文档图表，需要跨手册推理，并定位为模型策展的测试平台而非人工验证的黄金标准。在三个基准上，TrioRAG匹配或超越基于图的系统，同时降低总成本并将每次查询推理加速1.6至2.3倍。在该设定下图像检索仅达19.3%的文档级召回，而文本衍生信号尤其是VLM增强查询保持检索稳健。

papers.title: Earth Surface Immune System for Rapid Monitoring of Unknown Anomalies
papers.reason: 关键词命中：Remote Sensing、Foundation Model
papers.abstract: Earth surface anomalies, driven by escalating climate change, and expanding human activities, are increasing in both frequency and diversity, yet their limited historical data and unpredictability make them fundamentally different from conventional remote sensing targets. Existing methods address specific anomaly categories or stop at localization, leaving a gap between detection and actionable information. Here we present ESIA, an Earth Surface Immune System whose architecture is constrained by three principles from the biological immune system, refined over millions of years against equally diverse and uncertain threats. A non-specific innate immune stage treats anomalies as unobserved changes in time-series satellite imagery, generating binary localization maps at 14.51 km2/s without assuming any anomaly category, surpassing the strongest general baseline by 37% in F1. A specific adaptive immune stage applies negative selection to filter text prompts and matches surviving prompts with localized image patches through a multi-modal foundation model, enabling open-vocabulary recognition of unknown anomaly attributes including category, affected area, and damage severity, with recognition F1 exceeding 80%. A mutation mechanism tunes minimal embeddings at test time, adapting to each scene in 3.26s using a single reference image pair. We validate ESIA on a global-scale dataset covering 19,801.60 km2 across six anomaly categories, comparing against 22 models, and further apply it to quantify degraded farmland in the Dnipro Delta following the Kakhovka Dam collapse and assess burn severity from 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles. This unprecedented flexibility in handling unknown anomalies opens new avenues for real-time disaster response and environmental surveillance.

papers.title: Cross-Architecture Foundation-Model Distillation for Edge Flood Segmentation
papers.reason: 关键词命中：Geospatial、Segmentation
papers.abstract: Geospatial foundation models can provide strong flood-segmentation performance, but their size limits deployment on memory-constrained edge hardware. We distill a 300-million-parameter Prithvi-EO-2.0 teacher, fine-tuned on the 252 manually labeled Sen1Floods11 training scenes, into a 0.7-million-parameter EfficientViT-B0 student. The teacher supervises additional unlabeled Sentinel-2 imagery, allowing the student training set to grow without new manual annotations. At the matched budget of 252 scenes, teacher-supervised training is competitive with direct training and improves STURM-Flood performance across tested configurations; a geometry-matched control shows that label source alone does not explain the difference. Scaling the teacher-supervised pool to 2,500 scenes narrows the remaining student--teacher gap: the float student reaches 0.787 water intersection over union on the Sen1Floods11 test split against 0.822 for the teacher, matches the teacher on STURM-Flood under our evaluation protocol, and remains below it on WorldFloods-v2. After activation replacement and quantization-aware training, the student runs as a 1.5-megabyte 8-bit integer (INT8) TensorRT engine on a Jetson Xavier NX at 5.57 milliseconds of graphics processing unit (GPU) compute per 512-by-512 image, with approximately 14 megabytes of runtime device memory. A fixed modified normalized difference water index (MNDWI) threshold is competitive with both models on the two clean external benchmarks, so we interpret those benchmarks as generalization tests rather than as evidence of learned-model superiority over a spectral rule. The results support the conclusion: foundation-model supervision can amplify a fixed manual annotation budget into a substantially larger training set and yield a compact, deployable edge model.

papers.title: Scene-Q: Confidence-Aware Coarse-to-Fine Querying of 3D Scenes with Selective VLM Reasoning

papers.abstract: Indoor mobile robots require open-vocabulary scene understanding that grounds natural-language queries in a consistent 3D map. papers.title: SoL-Pi: Recursively Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harness
papers.title_zh: SoL-Pi：递归扩展自动研究循环以实现高效智能体框架
papers.reason: 该文研究智能体框架的自动研究循环与token效率，属于LLM与多智能体方向，与研究中LLM和多智能体兴趣相关，但不涉及地理空间或城市应用。
papers.abstract: As coding agents move from supervised code completion to unattended, around-the-clock exploration, their work expands from isolated predictions into long trajectories of reasoning, tool use, and feedback. Token efficiency therefore becomes important for scaling recursive self-improvement. We take an RSI-inspired approach at the harness layer, scaling auto-research loops across increasingly numerous and diverse environments for harness rollouts. At this scale, the process yields reusable improvements that transfer beyond their development setting, moving automated harness discovery toward production-level outcomes. Four mechanisms survive selection and form SoL-Pi, spanning action execution, context compaction, observation handling, and delegated reading. On the 51-task EdgeBench evaluation, SoL-Pi achieves performance comparable to Pi across GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 while reducing recorded token traffic by 44.7-49.0% and API cost by about one third. In other words, estimated hourly savings are \$8.75-\$13.50 relative to native Codex and Claude Code harnesses, and \$4.36-\$5.71 relative to Pi.
papers.summary_zh: 随着编码智能体从有监督的代码补全转向无人值守、全天候的探索，其工作从孤立的预测扩展为推理、工具使用和反馈的长轨迹。因此，token效率对于扩展递归自我改进变得重要。本文在框架层采取受递归自我改进启发的思路，在越来越多且多样的环境中扩展自动研究循环以进行框架推演。在这一规模下，该过程产生可复用的改进，并能迁移到开发环境之外，推动自动框架发现走向生产级成果。四种机制在筛选中存活并构成SoL-Pi，涵盖动作执行、上下文压缩、观测处理和委托阅读。在51项任务的EdgeBench评估中，SoL-Pi在GPT-5.6 Sol和Opus 5上取得与Pi相当的性能，同时将记录的token流量减少44.7%至49.0%，API成本降低约三分之一。换言之，相对于原生Codex和Claude Code框架，估计每小时节省8.75至13.50美元；相对于Pi，节省4.36至5.71美元。

papers.title: PhyRestore: Physics-Structured Latent-Factor Restoration
papers.title_zh: PhyRestore：物理结构化的潜因子恢复
papers.reason: 该文在流域尺度双时相栅格上研究土壤侵蚀变化估计，属于地理空间栅格建模与物理约束机器学习的交叉；其“恢复物理因子而非直接预测变化”的思路与遥感变化检测、多源数据融合中的噪声/缺失因子处理有较强方法关联，但研究对象为土壤侵蚀而非城市更新。
papers.abstract: Estimating temporal soil-loss change is challenging when physically meaningful input factors are noisy or corrupted, particularly because substantial changes are rare relative to the large number of locations exhibiting little change. We study this problem through the Revised Universal Soil Loss Equation (RUSLE) and introduce PhyRestore, a physics-structured latent-factor restoration framework. Rather than directly predicting soil-loss change or correcting a degraded physical estimate, PhyRestore restores corrupted physical factors and reconstructs temporal change through the known physical relationship. We evaluate PhyRestore in a watershed-scale bitemporal raster setting under isolated and simultaneous corruption of rainfall erosivity and cover management, comparing it with the degraded RUSLE estimate and Direct RF, XGBoost, MLP, and CNN models. Factor restoration improves high-magnitude recovery when the corrupted factors remain identifiable, but its advantage weakens under joint corruption, sparse positive extremes, and factor values outside the training support.
papers.summary_zh: 当物理意义明确的输入因子存在噪声或损坏时，估计土壤流失的时间变化十分困难，尤其因为显著变化相对于大量几乎不变的位置而言十分稀少。作者以修正通用土壤流失方程（RUSLE）为研究对象，提出 PhyRestore——一个物理结构化的潜因子恢复框架。它不直接预测土壤流失变化，也不修正退化的物理估计，而是恢复被损坏的物理因子，并通过已知的物理关系重建时间变化。作者在流域尺度双时相栅格场景下，对降雨侵蚀力和植被覆盖管理因子分别施加单独与同时损坏，并与退化 RUSLE 估计以及 Direct RF、XGBoost、MLP、CNN 模型比较。结果表明：当被损坏因子仍可辨识时，因子恢复能改善高量级变化的恢复效果；但在因子联合损坏、正极值稀疏以及因子值超出训练支持范围时，其优势减弱。
papers.insight_zh: 该文提示：在物理机理明确的栅格变化估计任务中，恢复中间物理因子可能比端到端直接预测更有效，但这一优势依赖于因子的可辨识性与训练分布覆盖。对遥感变化检测与多源数据融合而言，这是一种可借鉴的“物理约束+潜变量恢复”建模范式，不过其结论受稀疏极端事件与分布外因子限制。

papers.title: ParticleSplat: Self-supervised Object-centric Latent Particle Splatting
papers.title_zh: ParticleSplat：自监督对象中心潜在粒子泼溅
papers.reason: 该论文研究自监督对象中心潜在粒子泼溅与3D场景表示，属于3D视觉与对象中心学习，与遥感变化检测或多源数据融合有方法层面弱关联，但不涉及地理空间场景。
papers.abstract: We present ParticleSplat, a self-supervised object-centric learning method that decomposes scenes into a set of latent ''particles'' representing semantic entities through feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting. Building on the Deep Latent Particles (DLP) framework, which represents images as a set of particles with attributes such as position, scale, and visual appearance, we address a key limitation of DLP: its inherently 2D nature, which prevents explicit 3D spatial and geometric reasoning that are critical for downstream tasks such as robotic manipulation. Leveraging the structural similarity between latent particles and 3D Gaussian primitives, we introduce a 3D latent particle space trained with a novel view synthesis objective. Our model jointly encodes multiple views with camera poses into a shared 3D object-centric latent space, then transforms particles into particle-aligned 3D Gaussians whose composition reconstructs the full scene. On simulated and real-world datasets, we show that this formulation inherently learns object masks without supervision and supports controllable 3D scene editing, such as moving objects by modifying particles in the latent space. We further establish that the learned 3D representation improves downstream performance on robotic manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 作者提出ParticleSplat，一种自监督对象中心学习方法，通过前馈3D高斯泼溅将场景分解为一组表示语义实体的潜在“粒子”。该方法建立在Deep Latent Particles（DLP）框架之上，该框架将图像表示为具有位置、尺度和视觉外观等属性的粒子集合。作者解决了DLP的一个关键局限：其固有的2D性质阻碍了对机器人操作等下游任务至关重要的显式3D空间和几何推理。利用潜在粒子与3D高斯基元之间的结构相似性，作者引入一个用新视角合成目标训练的3D潜在粒子空间。模型联合编码带相机位姿的多视角图像到共享3D对象中心潜在空间，然后将粒子转换为粒子对齐的3D高斯，其组合重建完整场景。在仿真和真实数据集上，作者表明该公式无需监督即可固有地学习对象掩码，并支持可控3D场景编辑，例如通过修改潜在空间中的粒子来移动对象。作者进一步证明学习到的3D表示提升了机器人操作任务的下游性能。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提示：对象中心潜在粒子与3D高斯基元的结合可在无监督下获得对象掩码和可控编辑能力；若迁移到遥感或城市三维场景，可能有助于对象级变化检测与场景编辑，但论文未涉及地理空间数据。

papers.title: The Role of Fine-grained Harm Signals in LLM Safety
papers.title_zh: 细粒度危害信号在LLM安全中的作用
papers.reason: 该论文研究LLM内部细粒度危害信号在安全中的作用，属于LLM可解释性与安全研究，与研究中LLM主题相关，但不涉及地理空间应用。
papers.abstract: Prior work has shown that internal harmfulness representations in large language models vary across risk categories, while sharing a common general harm representation component. This raises a question about the role of the category-specific component beyond general harm representation in LLM safety. To answer this question, we isolate the category-specific component by removing shared general harmfulness representation from each categorical harmfulness representation, yielding a category residual that is orthogonal to general harmfulness at every layer. Using activation steering with category residuals across 11 risk categories in 3 instruction-tuned LLMs, we find that whether category residuals encode harmfulness varies across categories, and that this category-wise pattern is similar across models. Whether category residuals induce refusal also varies across categories, but this category-wise pattern is more model-dependent. We also find that category residuals increase LLMs' downstream internal alignment with shared general harmfulness representation. Together, these findings demonstrate that more fine-grained category residuals should also be considered beyond shared general harmfulness representation to fully understand LLM safety. More broadly, our findings show that even a direction orthogonal to a concept at one layer can contribute to the concept's downstream amplification.
papers.summary_zh: 先前工作表明，大语言模型内部的危害性表征在不同风险类别间存在差异，同时共享一个通用危害表征成分。这引出一个问题：类别特定成分在通用危害表征之外对LLM安全起什么作用。为回答该问题，作者通过从每个类别危害表征中移除共享的通用危害性表征，分离出类别特定成分，得到在每一层都与通用危害性正交的类别残差。作者在3个指令微调LLM的11个风险类别上使用类别残差进行激活引导，发现类别残差是否编码危害性因类别而异，且这种类别模式在不同模型间相似。类别残差是否引发拒绝也因类别而异，但这种类别模式更依赖模型。作者还发现类别残差增强了LLM下游内部与共享通用危害表征的对齐。这些发现共同表明，为充分理解LLM安全，除共享通用危害表征外还应考虑更细粒度的类别残差。更广泛地说，即使某一层上与某概念正交的方向，也能促进该概念的下游放大。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究揭示LLM安全中细粒度类别信号与通用危害表征的交互机制，对理解LLM内部表征有启发，但与地理空间智能研究无直接关联。

papers.title: Compositional Policy Violations: When Step-Level Compliance Fails In Agentic AI Workflows
papers.title_zh: 组合策略违规：当智能体AI工作流中步骤级合规失效
papers.reason: 该论文关注智能体工作流的组合策略违规与运行时治理，与多智能体方向相关，但不涉及地理空间或城市更新。
papers.abstract: Agentic workflows now make consequential decisions in regulated settings, and the governance placed around them is almost entirely step-scoped: input-output classifiers, per turn rails, and span-level evaluators. The policies organizations actually hold, such as referral thresholds, authority limits, and review requirements, are properties of the whole execution rather than of any one step. This mismatch admits a failure mode we call a Compositional Policy Violation (CPV): every individual step passes its own check while the composed execution violates the governing policy. A predicate over a single step cannot evaluate a property that step does not determine, so no improvement in the accuracy of the step-scoped monitors detects this class. We define CPVs as the failure of step-level compliance to compose, and present a taxonomy of four types: Authority Creep, Threshold Laundering, Cumulative Sum Violation, and Context Collapse. We show that the correct repair for each class is dictated by where the guarded quantity mutates. We then introduce a provenance-aware runtime architecture that evaluates policies over complete execution traces, recomputing guarded quantities from raw provenance rather than the pipeline's derived representation.
papers.summary_zh: 智能体工作流在受监管场景中做出重要决策，但治理几乎完全按步骤范围进行：输入输出分类器、每轮护栏、跨度级评估器。组织实际持有的策略，如转介阈值、权限限制、审查要求，是整个执行的属性而非任何单步属性。这种错配导致一种失败模式，称为组合策略违规（CPV）：每个单独步骤通过自身检查，但组合执行违反治理策略。单步谓词无法评估该步不决定的属性，因此步骤级监控器准确率提升无法检测此类。作者将CPV定义为步骤级合规无法组合的失败，提出四类分类：权限蔓延、阈值洗白、累积和违规、上下文崩溃。并表明每类正确修复取决于受保护量变异的位置。随后提出溯源感知运行时架构，在完整执行轨迹上评估策略，从原始溯源重新计算受保护量而非管道的派生表示。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作为多智能体工作流提供组合策略合规的运行时治理框架，若应用于城市更新中的多智能体决策流程，可能有助于检测跨步骤的规划合规问题，但摘要未涉及地理空间场景。

papers.title: Search-to-World: Evaluation of 3D World Delivery from User Request through Web Search
papers.title_zh: 从搜索到世界：通过网页搜索评估用户请求驱动的3D世界生成
papers.reason: 该研究涉及智能体系统、网络搜索和3D世界生成，与多智能体及多源数据融合有一定关联，但主题并非城市更新或地理空间智能，相关性中等。
papers.abstract: Agentic systems can interpret user requests, search the live web, and use external tools, but their ability to transform retrieved web content into a usable 3D world has not been systematically evaluated. No established end-to-end pipeline or benchmark exists for this capability. We introduce Search-to-World, an end-to-end evaluation task covering request understanding, web visual-content retrieval, and 3D-world delivery. We define Observed Retrieval Rate (ORR) and World Delivery Rate (WDR) to distinguish observing relevant content from successfully delivering a request-aligned, perceptually acceptable world. We also present WorldSearcher, a reuse-then-reconstruction harness that connects existing search agents to world delivery: it first retrieves reusable 3D worlds and, when none are available, reconstructs a world from video. A structured recovery controller revises temporal grounding, replaces source videos, or reformulates queries after failure. Using WorldSearcher, we benchmark representative models on Search-to-World and study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for recovery subagents. Results show that delivery depends on the underlying agentic model, and that relevant-content observation does not ensure world delivery. Jointly training recovery agents improves delivery success and action efficiency. Search-to-World makes agentic 3D-world delivery measurable, while WorldSearcher provides a practical evaluation harness with recovery capabilities.
papers.summary_zh: 提出了Search-to-World，一个端到端的评估任务，涵盖请求理解、网页视觉内容检索和3D世界生成。定义了观察检索率和世界生成率两个指标，并提出了WorldSearcher框架，该框架先尝试复用现有3D世界，若无则从视频重建。研究发现，相关内容的观察并不能保证世界的成功生成，且生成效果依赖于底层智能体模型。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究揭示了在智能体系统中，从信息检索到最终任务交付之间存在显著差距，强调了评估端到端能力而非单一环节的重要性。

papers.title: MTF-Net: Multi-Modal Temporal Feature Fusion Network for Pedestrian Intention Prediction
papers.title_zh: MTF-Net：面向行人意图预测的多模态时序特征融合网络
papers.reason: 该文提出多模态时序特征融合网络用于行人意图预测，涉及多模态融合与时空建模，与研究方向中的多源数据融合有方法关联，但应用场景为自动驾驶而非城市更新或遥感。
papers.abstract: Accurately predicting pedestrian intentions is crucial for ensuring safe and proactive interaction between autonomous vehicles and pedestrians. However, existing approaches often depend on architectures that either model temporal dependencies within individual modalities or fuse modalities only at coarse semantic levels. To address these limitations, we propose MTF-Net, a novel Multi-Modal Temporal Feature Fusion Network that jointly models kinematic, appearance, and contextual cues for pedestrian intention prediction. MTF-Net integrates four complementary modalities-bounding-box dynamics, human pose keypoints, local context, and scene-level semantics within a recurrent fusion framework enhanced by gated linear units (GLUs). These GLU-based modules adaptively regulate cross-modal information flow, enabling interpretable and efficient feature interaction across temporal scales. Through three dedicated temporal encoding branches and an attention-guided fusion head, the proposed model robustly anticipates pedestrian crossing intentions several frames before they occur. Extensive evaluations on the PIE and JAAD benchmarks demonstrate that MTF-Net surpasses recent transformer- and graph-based models, achieving up to 0.95 AUC on PIE and 0.94 AUC on JAAD, while maintaining real-time performance. The results highlight that reliable pedestrian intention prediction arises from principled multi-modal fusion rather than excessive architectural complexity.
papers.summary_zh: 准确预测行人意图对于确保自动驾驶车辆与行人之间安全且主动的交互至关重要。然而，现有方法常依赖仅在单模态内建模时间依赖或在粗语义层面融合模态的架构。为解决这些局限，作者提出MTF-Net，一种新颖的多模态时序特征融合网络，联合建模运动学、外观和上下文线索以预测行人意图。MTF-Net在由门控线性单元（GLU）增强的循环融合框架内整合四种互补模态——边界框动态、人体姿态关键点、局部上下文和场景级语义。这些基于GLU的模块自适应调节跨模态信息流，实现跨时间尺度可解释且高效的特征交互。通过三个专用时间编码分支和一个注意力引导融合头，该模型能在行人穿越意图发生前若干帧稳健预测。在PIE和JAAD基准上的广泛评估表明，MTF-Net超越近期基于Transformer和图的方法，在PIE上达到最高0.95 AUC，在JAAD上达到0.94 AUC，同时保持实时性能。结果强调，可靠的行人意图预测源于有原则的多模态融合，而非过度复杂的架构。
papers.insight_zh: 该文关于门控跨模态融合与多时间尺度编码的设计，可启发城市时空多源数据（如遥感、轨迹、社交媒体）的融合建模；其“融合原则优于架构复杂度”的结论对地理空间智能中的多源融合具有参考价值。
